snippet.title: Please, Watch The Artwork - Official Gameplay Trailer | Day of the Devs: Summer Game Fest Edition
snippet.description:
Sink into the ultimate liminal experience. Part psychological horror, part hidden object game, Please, Watch The Artwork tasks you with, well, watching art during a gallery night shift... but you'll soon notice strange things happening in the paintings.

Please, Watch The Artwork will be coming soon to PC, Switch, and mobile.
